component.name: Toast
component.description: A bottom-left transient message confirming or reporting the result of an action (settings save, task creation).

commonPatterns.name: save-confirmation
commonPatterns.description: Confirm a completed async action that doesn't need further user attention.

commonPatterns.name: action-error
commonPatterns.description: Report a non-blocking error from an action just taken.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Toast for anything requiring a user response
Using Toast to show a persistent status
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Badge on the relevant Card

parentConstraints: Fixed bottom-left position — deliberately paired with the FAB at bottom-right so they never overlap

accessibility.screenReader: announced automatically via aria-live without requiring focus to move

aiHints.context: Use for routine async confirmations/errors only. Auto-dismiss default variant; keep error variant visible longer.
